description: This file implements a benchmarking server for inference using PyTorch, including classes for frontend and backend workers that handle GPU requests, measure latency, throughput, and GPU utilization, and manage model loading and inference execution.

classes.name: FrontendWorker
classes.description: A process class that sends inference requests to a backend, measures latency, throughput, and GPU utilization.

classes.name: BackendWorker
classes.description: A class that loads a ResNet model, performs inference on incoming data, and responds with results.

methods.name: _run_metrics
methods.description: Collects response times and calculates latency metrics and throughput.

methods.name: _run_gpu_utilization
methods.description: Polls GPU utilization using nvidia-smi and records average GPU utilization.

methods.name: _send_requests
methods.description: Sends warmup and inference requests to the backend process.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method for FrontendWorker, manages threads for sending requests and collecting metrics.

methods.name: _setup
methods.description: Loads and prepares the ResNet model, measures load and compile times.

methods.name: model_predict
methods.description: Performs model inference on input data within a CUDA stream.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Copies data into GPU memory asynchronously.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Sends inference results back through the response queue.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes multiprocessing, starts frontend and backend workers, handles profiling, and saves metrics.
